scores.rationale: No named investment option has a concrete fact tied specifically to selective innovative or early-stage exposure. Broad-market technology concentration and general AI commentary do not establish that connection.
The report does not explicitly compare an option providing selective innovative or early-stage exposure with an option providing no emerging-technology exposure.
Selective innovative or early-stage exposure is not used to change any recommendation, inclusion, exclusion, ranking, or secondary fit judgment.

The recommendation permits limited optional stock exposure rather than categorically excluding it, making selective exposure implicitly compatible with the plan. However, the report never identifies innovative or early-stage investments as part of that permitted exposure, so preference-specific alignment remains incomplete.
